en.title: Fed Raises Rates in First Major Step by Warsh to Contain Inflation

en.title: House passes Russia and Iran sanctions bill championed by Sen. Lindsey Graham
en.summary: The House of Representatives passed a sanctions bill targeting Russia and Iran that was championed by the late Senator Lindsey Graham.

stories.title: House passes Russia sanctions bill, overcoming Democratic opposition

en.title: House passes Russia sanctions bill, overcoming Democratic opposition
en.summary: The House approved a Russia sanctions bill championed by Republican Senator Lindsey Graham, who had reached a White House agreement on the measure before his recent death.

stories.title: Federal Reserve raises interest rates for the first time since 2023

en.title: Federal Reserve raises interest rates for the first time since 2023
en.summary: The Federal Reserve increased its benchmark interest rate by 0.25 percentage points in response to rising inflation attributed to elevated energy prices.

en.title: Fed raises interest rates, a sign of concern about rising prices: "Inflation is too high"
en.summary: The Federal Reserve raised interest rates for the first time in three years amid concerns about inflation, while diesel fuel prices reached record highs for the eighth consecutive day.

en.title: House passes late Sen. Lindsey Graham's Russia sanctions bill, sending it to Trump's desk
en.summary: The House passed a Russia sanctions bill that was championed by the late Senator Lindsey Graham, and it now proceeds to the President's desk for consideration.

stories.title: House passes bill to shield Americans from data center energy costs

en.title: House passes bill to shield Americans from data center energy costs
en.summary: The House passed legislation addressing data center energy costs as lawmakers respond to growing pressure from the AI-driven expansion of data centers across the country.

stories.title: House Passes Bill Taking Aim at Data Center Electricity Costs

en.title: House Passes Bill Taking Aim at Data Center Electricity Costs
en.summary: The House approved a bill directing state regulators to consider requiring data centers to absorb higher energy costs, though states would not be mandated to implement such rules.

stories.title: House passes bill to shield consumers from data center price hikes on energy

en.title: House passes bill to shield consumers from data center price hikes on energy
en.summary: The House passed legislation protecting consumers from energy price increases linked to AI data centers, which have become a significant issue in midterm election campaigns.

stories.title: House passes Russia sanctions bill named for Lindsey Graham, sending it to Trump

en.title: House passes Russia sanctions bill named for Lindsey Graham, sending it to Trump
en.summary: The House approved legislation previously passed by the Senate that would impose sanctions on Russia's energy sector by targeting major purchasers of its oil and gas, aiming to reduce revenues Russia uses for military operations in Ukraine.

stories.title: House passes Russia sanctions, sending bill named for Lindsey Graham to Trump's desk

en.title: House passes Russia sanctions, sending bill named for Lindsey Graham to Trump's desk
en.summary: The House approved a Russia sanctions bill named after the late South Carolina Republican, which authorizes the president to impose tariffs on countries like China and India that are major importers of Russian oil and natural gas.

stories.title: Fed raises interest rates by quarter point to tackle inflation

en.title: Fed raises interest rates by quarter point to tackle inflation
en.summary: The Federal Reserve raised interest rates by a quarter percentage point to address inflation, which increases borrowing costs for businesses and consumers.

en.summary: The Nikkei index gained 1.0% as investors engaged in bargain-hunting while easing crude oil momentum provided support for Japanese equities, particularly in pharmaceutical and machinery sectors.

en.summary: While Federal Reserve rate increases generally support the dollar, limited divergence in central bank policies globally may constrain significant further appreciation of the currency.

en.summary: Gold prices rose slightly in early Asian trading following a decline that occurred after the Federal Reserve's first interest rate increase in more than three years.

en.title: Oil Falls Amid Hopes to Contain Mideast Crude Supply Disruption
en.summary: Oil prices declined in early Asian trading, with analysts attributing the drop to optimism that the significant disruption to Middle East crude oil exports could be controlled.

stories.title: U.S. Markets Sell Off After Fed’s Warsh Says Inflation Is Still ‘Too High’

en.title: U.S. Markets Sell Off After Fed's Warsh Says Inflation Is Still 'Too High'
en.summary: All three major U.S. stock indexes fell for the seventh time in eight sessions following comments from a Federal Reserve official emphasizing that inflation remains problematic.
